name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
label: Quest
description: First Mate Crazz has learned that the Bloodsail Buccaneers intend to launch an assault against Booty Bay. The scale of the threat demands the attention…
intro: First Mate Crazz has learned that the Bloodsail Buccaneers intend to launch an assault against Booty Bay. The scale of the threat demands the attention of the Blackwater Raiders' commander, Fleet Master Seahorn, who needs to hear the warning immediately.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Shiver me timbers! So the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning some sort of attack on Booty Bay? Why, the nerve of those scoundrels. Booty Bay will always be run by the Blackwater Raiders!
This is bigger than I thought. Report what you have learned to Fleet Master Seahorn at once! The ol' sea dog is around town somewhere....

clips.title: Completion
paras: Bloodsail Buccaneers attacking Booty Bay? They might as well throw themselves off the Overlook Cliffs. Nonetheless, by bringing me this information you have done my fleet of swashbucklers a great service. The Blackwater Raiders thank you.
